question: List the top 3 networks that have the most subnets, considering only RBAC entries where the action is 'access_as_shared' and the RBAC target tenant is public access (i.e., target_tenant = '*'). For each of these networks, return the network object ID and the number of subnets on that network. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT n.id AS network_id, COUNT(s.id) AS subnet_count
FROM networks n
JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id
JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = n.id
WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared'
  AND r.target_tenant = '*'
GROUP BY n.id
ORDER BY subnet_count DESC
LIMIT 3;

(SELECT avg_subnet_count FROM AvgTop3) ORDER BY i.subnet_count DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT sd.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, sd.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.IP_VERSION AS a.avg_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr CROSS JOIN AvgStdAttr AS a), SubnetDnsCvAboveAvg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT r.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.name = i.subnet_name WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT s1.subnet_name, s1.subnet_cidr, s1.rbac_target_tenant, s1.window_column, s1.deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id, s2.coefficient_of_variation FROM SubnetRbacWindowAndDeviation AS s1 JOIN SubnetDnsCvAboveAvg AS s2 ON s2.subnet_name = s1.subnet_name WHERE s1.rbac_target_tenant IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') ORDER BY s2.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(admin_state_up) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE CAST(admin_state_up AS CHAR) END AS admin_state_up, COUNT(DISTINCT network_id) AS total_networks, MAX(standard_attr_updated_at) AS max_standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY admin_state_up WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version, s.gateway_ip FROM `networkrbacs` AS n JOIN `subnets` AS s ON n.object_id = s.network_id WHERE n.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n.target_tenant = '*' GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE name END AS name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(gateway_ip) = 1 AND GROUPING(name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(gateway_ip) = 1 AND GROUPING(name) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE gateway_ip END AS gateway_ip, MAX(max_ip_version) AS max_ip_version, COUNT(*) AS total_groups FROM inner_cte GROUP BY name, gateway_ip WITH ROLLUP) SELECT q1.admin_state_up, q1.total_networks, q1.max_standard_attr_updated_at, q2.name AS subnet_name, q2.gateway_ip, q2.max_ip_version, q2.total_groups FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2 ORDER BY q1.admin_state_up, q2.name, q2.gateway_ip

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subnet_details AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), top_shared_networks AS (SELECT n.OBJECT_ID AS network_id, COUNT(*) AS subnet_count FROM `networkrbacs` AS n JOIN `subnets` AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.OBJECT_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT tsn.network_id, tsn.subnet_count, sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.TENANT_ID AS subnet_tenant_id, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, sd.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM top_shared_networks AS tsn JOIN subnet_details AS sd ON sd.NETWORK_ID = tsn.network_id ORDER BY tsn.subnet_count DESC, tsn.network_id, sd.NAME) SELECT i.network_id, i.subnet_count, i.subnet_name, i.subnet_tenant_id, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.allocation_pool_first_ip, i.allocation_pool_last_ip, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(max_standard_attr_id_next2) AS avg_max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte) AS a ON 1 = 1 WHERE i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 > a.avg_max_standard_attr_id_next2 ORDER BY i.subnet_count DESC, i.network_id, i.subnet_name
